business_summary.text: SEDEMAC Mechatronics designs and supplies control-intensive electronic control units (ECUs) to vehicle and industrial OEMs in India, the US and Europe.

call_points.text: Commodity inflation and semiconductor supply tightening raised raw-material cost and cut EBITDA margin a bit in Q1FY27.
ISG ECU introduction is underway on variants of three top-10 motorcycle models of three of the top four OEMs.
Two wet-magneto launches were expected in Q1FY27; one is in production and the second is imminent.
A third wet-magneto launch is expected in Q4FY27.
E2W MCU ramp-up is in play after start of production in Q3FY26.
ISG ECUs for export three-wheelers started production in Q4FY26 and are ramping up.
The US hurricane season could affect the US home-standby generator market; no adverse effect seen so far.
FY27 dampeners: commodity inflation and tighter semiconductor supply expected to put mild pressure on EBITDA percentage.
Land acquired in Shoolagiri for future shipments to southern India customers.
Three out of top four two-wheeler OEMs in India use SEDEMAC's sensorless ISG.
Power tools: first business win with a small power tool maker; SOP expected over next four to five quarters.
Working capital investment of ₹135 Cr for ₹1,058 Cr revenue, about 13%.
Customer concentration metric (biggest customer minus next four) has declined over three financial years.
EV products were 7.4% of two/three-wheeler revenue in FY26; management sees this as balanced exposure.
Management declined to give FY27/FY28 capex budget, product-level margins, order book or volume targets.

guidance.statement: ISG to be introduced on three top-10 motorcycle models from three OEMs; two launches expected in Q1 FY27, one in Q4 FY27.
MF3 ECU shipments expected from Q2 FY27.
MF4 electric-machine shipments expected from Q3 FY27.
After-treatment controller for CV market likely to enter production in H2 FY27.
Power tool motor controller SOP likely over next four to five quarters.
EBITDA margin expected to hold or improve for the rest of FY27 versus Q1FY27

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: FY26: 8.4 million two/three-wheelers produced with ISG in India vs 5.1 million three years ago; SEDEMAC accounted for over 80% of FY26 ISG volume growth.
FY26: EV products were 7.4% of two/three-wheeler revenue.
FY26: exports were about $10 million, all in the genset space.
Control-intensive ECUs sold in TTM Q1FY27 were 4,201,939, against 2,747,383 in TTM Q1FY26, with over 13 million sold cumulatively.
TTM Q1FY27 revenue split was ₹1,008 Cr mobility and ₹142 Cr industrial, with RoCE of 42%.
E2W MCU production started in Q3FY26 and ISG ECUs for export three-wheelers in Q4FY26; both are ramping up.

timeline.summary: On 18 May 2026 SEDEMAC held its first post-listing earnings call, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹1,058 Cr (up 61%), 21% EBITDA margin and 40% RoCE, and flagging ISG adoption on three top-10 motorcycles in FY27.

SEDEMAC's July 2026 investor presentation reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹310 Cr (+43% YoY), EBITDA of ₹60 Cr (+31%) and PAT of ₹33 Cr (+95%), with management flagging input-cost pressure and guiding to flat-to-better EBITDA margin for the rest of FY27.
